message.content:
Heavy wool coat, straight cut, knee length, #2a2530, dense felt.
Silk-blend blouse, tailored fit, hip length, #f2dcd6, smooth weave.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, tapered ankle, calf length, #7fa6c8, thick ponte knit.
Leather ankle boots, rounded toe, mid-calf height, #1c191b, water-resistant calfskin.
Wool-blend scarf, loose drape, shoulder length, #aeb2ba, soft merino blend.
Pearl stud earrings, small gauge, earlobe length, white luster, freshwater pearls set in sterling silver.

This outfit works perfectly for a brisk winter walk to work because the thick felt coat and water-resistant boots provide essential protection against -15°C temperatures, falling snow, and salted roads. The straight cut of the coat and wide-leg trousers create a long, vertical line that ensures warmth without bulk, while the wool-blend scarf adds an extra layer of insulation around the neck. Neutral dark tones dominate to keep you warm and professional, with subtle accents in your skin tone, eye color, and hair hex codes ensuring the look feels personalized yet polished for the office environment.
